name_zh: 萨帕塔/墨西哥/土地/自由/南方/艾米利亚诺/萨帕塔/萨帕塔
description_zh: 艾米利亚诺·萨帕塔 (1879-1919) 墨西哥革命领导人，领导南方革命，推动土地改革和自由，被誉为 "南方革命者", 对拉美土地改革产生深远影响，萨帕塔精神成为拉美革命象征。
description_en: Emiliano Zapata (1879-1919) Mexican revolutionary leader, led Southern Revolution, promoted land reform and liberty, known as "Southern Revolutioner", had profound impact on Latin American land reform, Zapata spirit became Latin American revolution symbol.
reason_zh: 萨帕塔代表拉美革命者如何通过土地改革实现社会转型，如何通过革命斗争推动国家解放，以及如何建立革命精神影响拉美历史，体现了拉美革命精神。
reason_en: Zapata represents how Latin American revolutionaries achieve social transformation through land reform, promote national liberation through revolutionary struggle, and establish revolutionary spirit influence Latin American history, embodies Latin American revolutionary spirit.
steps_zh: 研究萨帕塔早年土地所有者生涯/革命意识形成/土地改革思想
分析1910 年革命爆发/南方革命/土地改革
探讨土地改革/国际关系/革命斗争
评估南方革命/土地改革/墨西哥经济
总结革命遗产/墨西哥现代国家/萨帕塔精神
steps_en: Study Zapata early landowner career/revolutionary consciousness formation/land reform idea
Summarize revolution legacy/Mexican modern state/Zapata spirit
expected_zh: 理解拉美革命者如何通过土地改革实现社会转型，如何通过革命斗争推动国家解放，以及如何建立革命精神影响拉美历史。
expected_en: Understand how Latin American revolutionaries achieve social transformation through land reform, promote national liberation through revolutionary struggle, and establish revolutionary spirit influence Latin American history.
